scope: native-resolution lidar scarp lane; one lane experiment; zero submission slots

passes.title: Implement and measure
actions: reassembled and hash-verified the 19-band stack (418,912,844 B, sha256 4371c82e…) from five mirror parts
rewrote build_features for the 3 GB sandbox (float32 throughout, DEM block freed before the lidar stack, streaming top-2 corroboration, explicit deletes, [mem] checkpoints)
added the MCLP surface-coverage baseline (lazy greedy, capped scan, cap reported) and the strike-line keep-fraction arms
replaced the single-draw holdout with a three-seed truth ensemble (seeds 20/21/22 x 4 whole-component folds) and removed dots that land on the fold-hidden catalogue before scoring
added cross-fitted arm selection (12 held-out folds) and per-seed paired deltas
added gems57.uniqueness.dense_prior_certificate with matched random controls, plus a standalone CLI
added scripts/pin_inputs.py and evidence/input_pins.json so every input byte is re-verified each run
passes.result: run completed; 8 arms scored; winner D_spacing34_flank2 pooled 0.05040 vs spacing 0.04514, MCLP 0.03355, random control 0.03754, historical base 0.02892; all margins > 2 paired SE; selection chosen in 12/12 held-out folds

passes.title: Review and fix
defects_found_and_fixed: certificate unsatisfiability was initially gated on an assumed 50 % support rule; replaced by the measured control test (a prior is saturating only when its matched random controls already exceed the 70 % limit)
the dense-prior explanation in the run card and the site therefore had to be regenerated from the measured rows; done via the standalone certificate and scripts/refresh_card_certificate.py
the site checker still encoded the old publish-nothing policy; rewritten to a three-state rule (cleared / audit artefact with stated diagnostics / blocked), with byte-level integrity against the card
the run card note said 2.8 px while the selected arm was 3.4 px; driver default and card corrected
scripts/validate_submission.py could not import the shared package and pointed at a non-existent sample path; both fixed
stale site pages and stale downloads from earlier runs removed so the published site cannot contradict the card
passes.result: check_site green (6 pages, 0 problems), pytest 46 passed

passes.title: Re-check and improve
actions: re-derived the uniqueness certificate standalone from the written bytes (63 priors, 8 controls each) and refreshed the card through the shared promotion policy instead of editing the verdict
re-ran the on-disk validator on the published file: format pass, 18/18 checks, 39,191 positive cells, 0 on the catalogue
recorded the evidence-class ledger (evidence/claim_ledger.json) and the access blockers (evidence/access_blockers.json) so every claim can be falsified from its source
passes.result: verdict negative on the literal registry gate only; diagnostic verdict unique; download published as a labelled audit artefact; slots used 0

unresolved: literal registry gate unsatisfiable while saturating priors are indexed (5 of 63 here); protocol decision belongs to the owner
